text: Overdosage Do not put too much Spotex on your skin. You will not get rid of the acne any quicker. If you put on too much, your skin may become irritated and red. Some peeling or discomfort could also occur. If any of these happen, use Spotex once a day in the evening until they have gone. Then apply Spotex twice a day as you did previously. If the effects continue or are causing you a lot of discomfort, stop using the product and ask your doctor or pharmacist for advice. In the rare event that you accidentally swallow any of this product, seek medical advice.
